_meta.description: Major U.S. retirement plan recordkeepers and how a former employee reaches them. Most lost 401(k) accounts sit with one of these firms, so this table converts a dead end into a phone call.
_meta.verifyNote: URLs are link-checked by build/qa.js. Phone numbers should be re-verified quarterly. ReclaimWealth is not affiliated with any firm listed here; these are public contact details published by each company.
_meta.usage: Powers /find/<slug>.html pages and the 'who holds my old plan' step of the search plan.

administrators.name: Fidelity Investments
administrators.notes: One of the largest 401(k) recordkeepers in the U.S. Former employees can often log in with an existing username, or re-register using their Social Security number and date of birth.

administrators.name: Empower
administrators.notes: Empower acquired the retirement businesses of Prudential, MassMutual, and Great-West. If your old plan was with any of those, it is very likely at Empower now.

administrators.name: Vanguard
administrators.notes: Vanguard transferred a large portion of its recordkeeping business to Ascensus. If Vanguard has no record of your plan, check Ascensus next.

administrators.name: Principal Financial Group
administrators.notes: Principal acquired Wells Fargo's institutional retirement business, so former Wells Fargo-administered plans often moved here.

administrators.name: Voya Financial
administrators.notes: Formerly ING U.S. Plans administered by ING before 2014 are generally now with Voya.

administrators.name: TIAA
administrators.notes: Dominant in higher education, hospitals, and non-profits. If you worked for a university or a non-profit, start here.

administrators.name: Charles Schwab
administrators.notes: Schwab Retirement Plan Services administers many mid-size and large employer plans.

administrators.name: Ascensus
administrators.notes: A very large recordkeeper for small-business plans, and the destination for much of Vanguard's former recordkeeping book.

administrators.name: ADP Retirement Services
administrators.notes: Common where the employer also used ADP for payroll — frequent among small and mid-size businesses.

administrators.name: Paychex
administrators.notes: Like ADP, often the recordkeeper when the employer used Paychex for payroll.

administrators.name: John Hancock Retirement
administrators.notes: Manulife acquired and consolidated several small-plan books into John Hancock Retirement.

administrators.name: Transamerica
administrators.notes: Serves a wide range of employer plan sizes, including many mid-market employers.

administrators.name: Nationwide Retirement Solutions
administrators.notes: Strong presence in public-sector 457(b) and governmental plans.

administrators.name: Corebridge Financial (formerly AIG Retirement / VALIC)
administrators.notes: Formerly VALIC and AIG Retirement Services. Common in healthcare, education, and public-sector 403(b) plans.

administrators.name: Milliman
administrators.notes: Administers many large defined benefit pension plans as well as defined contribution plans.
